work.englishTitle: MAXQ Special Edition Vol. 10: Park Eunhye
work.summary: Digital MAXQ Special Edition featuring Korean YouTube creator Park Eunhye (Jamong). RIDI identifies the exact Vol. 10 product and describes the Special Edition series as selected MAXQ pictorials not previously released online. The product is a distinct retail title; photographic overlap with Park's other MAXQ/Secret B titles is unverified, so no image uniqueness is asserted. Bibliographic metadata only; no cover or paid PDF copied.
